title: Financial Analytics
skill: Financial Analytics reads posted GL Entry rows only - draft and cancelled entries are excluded by the source query, not by this playbook. Net Movement is debit minus credit; a negative account balance is not automatically an error, it depends on the account's root type (Asset/Expense debit-normal vs Liability/Income/Equity credit-normal). When a user asks 'why did this spike', check the anomaly panel before proposing a cause - it already ran isolation-forest over the same series.
